title: Restock policy
content: Out-of-stock items are typically restocked within 2 to 3 weeks. You can ask the assistant whether a specific product is in stock.

title: Returns and exchanges
content: Items may be returned within 30 days of delivery for a full refund, provided they are unworn and in original condition.

title: Shipping
content: Standard shipping is complimentary on all orders over $500. Orders below $500 have a flat $15 shipping fee. Express shipping is available at checkout.
